subject: Graduate Engineer, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I'm applying for the Graduate Engineer role advertised on SEEK. The ad describes estimating, tender documents and document control on façade drawings for graduates with up to two years' experience, and cost estimates and bills of quantities were part of my coursework.

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, where I prepared cost estimates and bills of quantities, reviewed technical drawings, and drew road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater designs in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. My degree is a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). On site in the Philippines from April 2019 to February 2020 I reviewed structural and architectural drawings, tracked procurement and materials, kept material and progress records, and coordinated with suppliers.

I have no façade experience and no work experience in Australia yet, and I haven't used Aconex or Procore. I use Excel for everyday spreadsheets, not modelling. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria and open to discussing relocation to Sydney.

My drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd be glad to talk about the estimating work.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

notes:
CCYE (ccye.com.au, Rhodes NSW) is a plasterboard, cladding and joinery fit-out subcontractor (NSW licence class Dry Plasterer), not an engineering consultancy; the SEEK "civil/structural engineering team" wording is classification language. The role is graduate estimating and document control on façade drawings, 0 to 2 years, recent graduates encouraged. Fit lowered to 62 for the industry mismatch; Marc decides whether a fit-out estimating start suits him. The ad's "Professional Engineer in Training status or willingness to pursue" is left to Marc. No published contact beyond info@ccye.com.au (not stated to take applications), so SEEK is the only route. Interstate: Sydney relocation is Marc's call.
Checked 2026-09-29. WHAT THE COMPANY DOES: CCYE (ccye.com.au, Unit 2/23 Leeds St, Rhodes NSW 2138) is a fit-out and facade subcontractor, not a consulting engineering firm: its site says it specialises in installing plasterboard walls, ceilings and partition systems including Hebel panels, and its service pages list CFC, metal, aluminium and timber cladding, window and glazing partitions, metal fabrication, joinery and design, using its own metal and joinery factories. Home page lists completed projects as subcontractor (Royal Plaza Hurstville, Parkland Estate Rouse Hill, Phoenix Rouse Hill, UNO Apartment Green Square) and ISO 9001/14001/45001 certification. NSW contractor licence 295240C (class Dry Plasterer, current to 18 Apr 2027, ACN 168 890 775; licensee address on the register is U1/3 Sutherland St Clyde NSW, the website address is Rhodes). A third-party ANCR magazine feature (https://ancr.com.au/tag/hebal-panels/, full article https://ancr.com.au/cladding-engineering-delivering-thermal-performance-architectural-precision/) describes CCYE delivering lightweight internal lining and the full external cladding system across five towers at Alba at Square and a newly established cladding manufacturing facility. This matches the advert's estimating/document-control duties on facade drawings and cladding; the advert's 'Civil/Structural Engineering team' wording is SEEK classification language rather than a description of a design practice. WHAT WAS CHECKED: SEEK page not fetched (403 rule; advert text taken from candidates.json). ccye.com.au home, about, contact and cladding pages read (plain curl got HTTP 406 from Mod_Security; a browser user agent worked). No team, staff, news, careers or capability-statement page exists; no PDF or document links on the site; the only email anywhere on the site is info@ccye.com.au and the contact page says only 'We love to hear from you' with a web form, with no statement that it accepts job applications or employment enquiries. WebSearch for "@ccye.com.au" returned only the CCYE home page; searches for the company with director/estimating manager/operations manager, and for employer-authored PDFs, tenders, council or capability documents, found none. Data broker and directory results (ZoomInfo, Dun & Bradstreet, RocketReach, magicpin, White Pages) were not opened or used. NSW Verify licence page was rendered with browse.py (WebFetch saw only a JS shell) and names directors Jie Yang and Yan Wang; their home addresses and years of birth shown there are private and deliberately omitted. The About page contains a bare heading 'Keith Keller' with no role, photo or bio; this is a common Elementor template placeholder name and is not treated as a real staff member. The Estimating Manager and Operation Manager named in the advert are not identified anywhere. RESULT: no employer-published direct email exists, and info@ccye.com.au does not qualify as a published application inbox, so contact_confidence is none. The advert asks for CV, academic transcripts and a cover letter and has SEEK screening questions; the route is the SEEK Apply button, to be lodged by Jeremie. Do not email info@ccye.com.au or any built address.

subject: Trainee Traffic Signals Designer, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I'm applying for the Trainee Traffic Signals Designer role advertised on SEEK. The ad asks for up to two years in design, drafting or CAD documentation and says signals experience isn't required, and my two years of design and drafting are the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design I finished in February 2026.

In that coursework I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards and Austroads guides, and the standards covered included AS 1742.14, the traffic signals part of the Manual of Uniform Traffic Control Devices. My degree is a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). On site in the Philippines from April 2019 to February 2020 I carried out inspections and checked the work against the drawings.

I have no traffic signal, lighting or ITS experience yet, and my CAD work is from study. I hold an Australian driver's licence, a White Card and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria, and open to discussing how the occasional South-East Queensland attendance would work, including relocation.

My drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd be glad to talk.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
